attemptsHint: A failed task is retried in its own chat until it has had this many; then you decide
noPlan: The planner {{outcome}} without a plan. Its conversation is on the chat page; you can re-plan or write the tasks by hand.

board.hintSentBody: {{name}} will see it with its next step.
board.hintExplained: A hint is added to what this worker is doing now. It does not answer back here: the task carries on, and its result is what the graph waits for. To talk it through, wait for it to finish and fork its chat.
board.hintPlaceholder: One thing it should know or change
board.retryTitle: One more execution of the same chat, in the worktree it left, told what went wrong
board.retryCleanBody: Its worktree is removed and its branch deleted, and a new chat starts from the base commit. The old chat stays listed as a record of what was tried.
board.skipBody_one: It and everything that depends on it are skipped, and the graph finishes without that branch. The chats keep what they did; nothing is deleted.
board.skipBody_other: It and everything that depends on it are skipped, and the graph finishes without those branches. The chats keep what they did; nothing is deleted.
board.blockedNote: Waiting for a decision, not failed itself.
board.cannotStart_one: It cannot start until {{names}} is retried or given up.
board.cannotStart_other: It cannot start until {{names}} are retried or given up.
board.givenUp: Given up: the graph finishes without this branch.
board.forkTitle: A finished task is closed: to build on its work, fork its chat and continue in the copy
board.costTitle: Everything this task's chat cost, every attempt included
board.heldBoth: The integration and the synthesis are held until each is retried or given up.
board.heldSynthesis: The synthesis is held until each is retried or given up.
board.heldIntegration: The integration is held until each is retried or given up.
board.waitingTitle: Waiting for you: nothing is running
board.openChatBeside: Open its chat beside the graph

list.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, objective or task
list.title: Orchestrations
list.emptyBody: Split an objective into tasks and run them as agents in parallel. Start a new one, or begin from a template.
list.noMatchBody: Try another name, or clear the status filter.
